run.change_description:
feat(completion): support sourcing zsh completion dynamically

Summary:
Previously, you needed to save the completion script to a file and then
source it.  Now, you can dynamically source completions in zsh by
running

```zsh
$ source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)
```

Test plan:
1. Run `source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)`
2. Run `rg --generate=complete-zs<TAB>`

Before this commit, you would get an error after step 1.
After this commit, it should work as expected.

Closes #2956


improve FAQ text for zsh completions

summary.intent: Let zsh users load ripgrep completions with `source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)`, and document that and the `fpath` route in the FAQ.
summary.issue_fit: Met for the reported failure: once the completion system is loaded, sourcing the generated script registers `_rg` without the `_arguments` error. Two FAQ text defects remain as `consider` items.
summary.coverage: Both changed files read in full; scratch zsh 5.8.1 runs covered sourced, autoloaded and test-harness paths; `ci/test-complete` and Cargo were unavailable.
check_details: Reviewer ran scratch zsh 5.8.1 scripts outside the clone at the reviewed head: sourcing after `compinit` registers `_rg` with no error; the old file reproduces the issue's `_arguments` error; an autoloaded `_rg` sees `funcstack[1]` equal to `_rg`; the `ci/test-complete` sourcing pattern still dumps the specs; sourcing before `compinit` still errors.
`ci/test-complete` and Cargo build/test unavailable: no built `rg` and no vendored registry; settled by trace, since no Rust file changed and the test sources the script without `compdef`.

findings.title: Remove the `$` prompt from the `.zshrc` snippet
findings.trigger: A reader copies the block that the text tells them to add to `$HOME/.zshrc`; it begins with a `$ ` terminal prompt.
findings.impact: zsh reads `$` as a command and reports `command not found: $` at every shell start, so the completions are never loaded. The `fpath` block just above has no prompt.
findings.change: Drop the leading `$ ` so the block reads `source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)`.

findings.title: State where the new `.zshrc` lines go relative to `compinit`
findings.trigger: A reader appends the `source` line to a `.zshrc` where `compinit` runs later, or the `fpath` line where `compinit` has already run.
findings.impact: The `source` line prints `_rg:341: command not found: _arguments` at every shell start and registers nothing. The `fpath` line is silently ignored, with `rg` left uncompleted. Neither ordering is mentioned.
findings.change: Add one sentence: put the `fpath` line before `compinit` and the `source` line after it.

observations.fact: Thread 5 proposed dropping the FAQ patch for a later issue, but the head keeps the FAQ text, reworded by the maintainer in `855bfa6`, so that deferral is closed.
The `ci/test-complete` pattern, which sources the script with no `compdef` defined, still reaches `_rg "$@"` through the `compdef`-absent branch.

requirements.evidence: `rg.zsh:441-446` registers `compdef _rg rg` when `compdef` exists; scratch run A (sourced after `compinit`) shows `_comps[rg]=_rg` and no error.

requirements.source: commit-7c2a7b0/"you can dynamically source completions in zsh"
requirements.evidence: Same scratch run A; the autoload path (runs C, E) still calls `_rg` because `funcstack[1]` is `_rg`.

requirements.source: commit-7c2a7b0/"Before this commit, you would get an error after step 1"
requirements.evidence: Scratch run B_old on the merge-base file prints `_arguments:comparguments:325: can only be called from completion function`, the issue's error; run A on the head file prints nothing.
An interactive TAB session was not run; registration of `_rg` for `rg` was observed instead, and no executable `rg` was available.
